test_cases.name: resolves_spec_and_states_path
assertions: Uses the session's approved spec without asking and states its path in one line

test_cases.name: lists_specs_when_unresolved
assertions: Lists docs/physarum/specs/ and asks which one

test_cases.name: not_approved_fix_in_spec
assertions: Asks once whether the spec has been reviewed and approved unless already approved in this session
Stops and says to fix it in /spec when not approved

test_cases.name: invokes_update_spec_skill
assertions: Invokes the update-spec skill, or reads .agents/skills/agentic-os/update-spec/SKILL.md when the runtime cannot find it

test_cases.name: stops_and_does_not_edit_code
assertions: Does NOT edit code, because back-sync is a separate gate
